findings.finding: Hasbro's Q3 2026, the calendar quarter identical to Asmodee's fiscal Q2, had Magic: The Gathering revenue up 34% to $616m (first $600m quarter), with about $40m pulled forward from Q4; Asmodee distributes Magic in Europe (its Q1 report names 'Magic: The Gathering - Marvel Super Heroes' as a TCG growth driver), so the partner-TCG line had a strong sell-through quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: TCG/partner growth drove the last two beats: FY25/26 release +9.6% and Q1 FY26/27 release +11.1% (closes 2026-05-21 and 2026-08-04 from the Yahoo tape); Q2 FY25/26 (partners +30%) still fell 4.0% on consumer caution.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it was public on 2026-10-20 and consensus rose afterwards (SB1 477m sales on 10-07 vs Modular Finance 490m on 11-10, all 11 contributors updated). What remains is that Hasbro's Magic number was a step-change and sell-in through a European distributor can exceed a consensus built on group-level extrapolation; if fully priced the stock would have rerated after 10-20, and it is at 172.4 against 172.8 on 10-21.
findings.independence: Asmodee's own Q1 text naming Magic as a TCG driver: https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/aa35f38c25bff5d2cae0f46899381aafa

findings.finding: Two Pokemon TCG releases landed inside Asmodee's Q2: Pitch Black on 2026-07-17 and 30th Celebration on 2026-09-16, the latter the #1 sealed product by GMV on TCGplayer in September and described as releasing pent-up demand, offset by ICv2's report that Chaos Rising and Pitch Black secondary prices fell ~17-25% from late July ('cooling off').
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pokemon is the TCG engine (TCG +23.1% in Q1, stock +11.1%); in Q2 FY25/26 a hot Pokemon quarter came with a 4.0% fall on US consumer commentary.
findings.why_not_priced: US marketplace data, a proxy for Asmodee's European distribution sell-in, not in the company's own disclosure; the release date of 30th Celebration (Sept 16) puts its first sell-in inside the quarter, which a consensus anchored on Q1's +23% TCG rate may not fully carry. Partly priced: SB1 already cites Pokemon as a Q2 driver.
findings.independence: ICv2 cooling report (contrary direction, priced into the size): https://icv2.com/print/article/63244 ; SB1 preview citing Pokemon: https://www.placera.se/telegram/asmodee-sb1-asmodee-vantas-leverera-starkt-q2--kop-upprepas-20261007

findings.finding: The bar has been raised into the print: the Modular Finance consensus of 2026-11-10 (sales EUR 490m, +21.5% vs 403.4m; adj. EBITDA 97.4m, +28% vs 76.1m) sits above SB1 Markets' bullish preview of 2026-10-07 (477m sales, 84.6m adj. EBIT vs consensus 89.4m), against a comparable quarter that grew 23.4% organically.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 FY25/26: placera headlined 'Bättre än väntat' yet the stock fell 4.0% on 2025-11-20; Q3 FY25/26 record quarter, 'börsen gäspar', +1.5%.
findings.original_quote: SB1 (sv): "Försäljningen väntas öka 18 procent till 477 miljoner euro, medan justerat ebit väntas stiga 23 procent till 84,6 miljoner euro." (Sales expected +18% to EUR 477m, adj. EBIT +23% to 84.6m.)
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus itself is public, but the gap between it and the last published single-broker preview means the bar moved up late; a print 'in line with SB1' would now be a miss of ~2.7% on sales and ~5% on adj. EBIT. If the market already discounted a soft quarter the stock would not sit at 14% above its 60-day level.

findings.finding: Asmodee said in Q1 it expects 'to benefit from tariff refunds related to previously paid duties' in the coming quarters (EUR 1.3m booked in Q1 as items affecting comparability); Hasbro booked $55m of refunds in the same calendar quarter, so a refund inside Q2 reported EBIT is likely, but below the adjusted lines the market trades.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior Asmodee print where this line mattered; H&M (European, 2026-09) beat on a tariff refund and fell.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus operating profit of 75.8m may or may not include a refund; it is below adjusted EBITDA, so it could lift reported EBIT and net profit headlines without changing the adjusted bar; no path to guidance.
